display_name: HTTP Relay — Bring Your Own Endpoint

How to use this service.description: How HTTP Relay works and the two ways to use it — a stored endpoint (free) or per-enrollment endpoints (metered)

byok.description: Free — you relay to your own stored endpoint

plus.description: $1 for every 10,000 requests — pay only for what you relay

name: http-relay

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding the API key. Defaults to HTTP_RELAY_API_KEY (shared with the free byok channel) so empty-params enrollments reuse the seeded testing secret. Override per enrollment to bind a different key.

base_url.description: Upstream base URL for this enrollment, specified directly (e.g. https://api.example.com)
